gen-gf-paprika-fs-merriweather-sans: Paprika throws its letters wide and lets the lowercase fill the line like capitals, loud and a bit theatrical. And Merriweather Sans does the quieter job, with tall, sturdy words and an e that opens clearly to the right.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-nunito: Snowburst One looks like a cut stencil sheet, wide bridges between letters and tall lowercase standing proud. Nunito carries the reading with big round bowls and terminals that stop well clear of the stem, soft and friendly across many lines.
gen-megrim-fs-quicksand: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with every stroke finishing at one measured thickness, and its lowercase climbs skyward. Quicksand follows in rounded, glassy bowls with the same bar thickness running along the line, so the two feel related yet clearly different.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-merriweather-sans: Expressive is the word for Tektur, with pipe-cleaner strokes, generous openings on every curve and oversized lowercase. Merriweather Sans settles into tall, sturdy words and an e that opens to the right, which keeps a long page easy on the eye.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-nunito: Nunito reads soft and open, with round bowls and friendly terminals. Warnes is best at bold, stretched, pencil-like display lines that never thicken or thin, while Nunito is best at carrying sentences in a relaxed, approachable sans-serif voice.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-merriweather-sans: Commanding lettering comes from Wallpoet, with high-rising lowercase and paper showing through its lines between letters. Merriweather Sans sits beneath it as a sans-serif of tall, sturdy words, giving the page a loud top and a steady, readable base.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-nunito: Nunito reads round and approachable, its big bowls and open terminals sitting comfortably under a heading with a bookish, nostalgic streak. Mystery Quest supplies the old-storybook charm.
gen-syne-gf-faustina: Faustina reads like a confident, classic serif, its bowls thinning gently. Over a longer stretch it stays authoritative, with capitals only slightly taller than the lowercase and a pliers-like open c that keeps lines lively, while Syne stays bold above it.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-podkova: Podkova reads bookish and traditional, a text serif with a broad, welcoming c. Chubbo, drawn like marker with smooth round bowls, is the casual, inviting counterpart, and over many lines Podkova keeps things steady and warm.
gen-audiowide-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Audiowide looks like glowing tiles, tall lowercase with wide gaps and no thick-thin shift. And Be Vietnam Pro, a clean sans with strokes like bent steel rod, would suit a body size a notch smaller than the heading.
